# Acceptance-Criteria Quality Checklist: CV pages

**Purpose**: Check that the CV page, privacy, no-script, accessibility, responsive, 404 and visual-baseline requirements are complete, unambiguous and testable from `spec.md` alone: by a test author who never sees the plan or code, against `astro preview` or as module tests.
**Created**: 2026-11-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Depth: standard. Audience: PR reviewer of the spec (the owner) before the test author starts a gate task.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Does every bullet in the brief's feature input (privacy patterns, no `<script>`, 390px overflow, axe, exact view entries, `/cv/foo` 404, visual baselines) map to at least one numbered acceptance criterion? [Completeness, Spec §Acceptance Criteria]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the shown fields defined for every one of the eight sections, including which fields are never shown? [Completeness, Spec §Definitions, FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the content of the overview page fully listed, including what it must NOT show? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, AC-23]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the content of the 404 page specified enough to be recognised by a test (heading text, link, title)? [Completeness, Spec §AC-19, AC-37]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements stated for both states of `meta.placeholder` (true, and false or absent)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, AC-36]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the set of routes each cross-cutting criterion (AC-30 to AC-38) applies to stated explicitly, per delivery slice? [Completeness, Spec §Delivery Slices]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "each view lists exactly the entries tagged for it" expressed as an exact, ordered comparison against expectations computed from the content file? [Clarity, Spec §AC-12]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the page hooks (`data-cv-section`, `data-cv-entry`, `nav[aria-label="CV views"]`, `data-cv-placeholder`, `data-cv-empty`) defined precisely enough to select content without reading the implementation? [Clarity, Spec §Page Structure Contract]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "text of an element" defined (whitespace handling) so text comparisons are unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §Definitions]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "no horizontal overflow at 390px" quantified with a viewport size, a timing point and a measurable comparison? [Clarity, Spec §AC-32]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "no client JS" defined beyond `<script>` elements (inline handlers, `javascript:` URLs, runtime script count)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, AC-31]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "private data" tied to a specific pattern source, including the optional gitignored terms file and how a missing file is treated? [Clarity, Spec §AC-30]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "zero axe violations" pinned to a rule set and to a point in time relative to the entrance animations? [Clarity, Spec §AC-33]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "hard-coded content" defined by an exact set of values, a length threshold and an explicit list of excluded files? [Clarity, Spec §AC-24, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the module interface (names, argument shapes, return shapes, error behaviour) stated well enough to write tests without the plan? [Clarity, Spec §View-Selection Contract]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK016 Is the section order identical everywhere it appears (Definitions table, `SECTION_ORDER`, AC-03, controller ruling)? [Consistency, Spec §Definitions, View-Selection Contract]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the skills rules consistent between the edge cases, FR-004, AC-05, AC-06 and AC-23 (skills without `views` only on the overview; skills with `views` on the overview and their views)? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK018 Do the view-link requirements agree between the overview (AC-22, no `aria-current`) and view pages (AC-16, current view marked)? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the trailing-slash route form used consistently in definitions, link `href`s and the 404 cases? [Consistency, Spec §Definitions, AC-16, AC-19]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the island rule in AC-38 consistent with DESIGN.md ("one or two to a page")? [Consistency, Spec §AC-38]
- [ ] CHK021 Does AC-17's ownership by CV3 avoid a build that links to a page not yet built in any slice order? [Consistency, Spec §Delivery Slices]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK022 Can every acceptance criterion except AC-51 be verified by a host-run Playwright test (browser or module-only) against the built site? [Measurability]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the reason AC-51 is verified by the gate's `visual` check rather than an acceptance test stated, along with who approves the baselines? [Measurability, Spec §AC-51]
- [ ] CHK024 Do the criteria compute expectations from the content file at test time rather than copying content into tests, so they stay valid when content changes? [Measurability, Spec §Acceptance Criteria preamble]
- [ ] CHK025 Is AC-20 (empty view state) testable with the current content, and is its behaviour defined for both outcomes? [Measurability, Spec §AC-20]
- [ ] CHK026 Is each acceptance criterion owned by exactly one delivery slice? [Traceability, Spec §Delivery Slices]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK027 Are the unknown-route cases enumerated (with and without trailing slash, nested under a valid view, outside `/cv/`)? [Coverage, Spec §AC-19]
- [ ] CHK028 Are entries tagged for several views, empty sections, absent section keys and empty views all addressed? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, AC-04, AC-07, AC-20]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the behaviour for profiles other than GitHub and LinkedIn specified? [Coverage, Spec §Definitions, AC-35]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the long-unbroken-text case tied to a measurable criterion (AC-32), not only listed as an edge case? [Coverage, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK031 Are case-variant view routes explicitly marked out of scope? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK032 Are the DESIGN.md rules that can be measured (18px body, italic `h1`/`h2`, grid paper, island count, mono notice, reduced motion) stated as criteria, and is the rest left to the design critic and visual baselines? [Coverage, Spec §AC-34, AC-38]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the constitution's location rule (no finer than "Ireland") reflected in what the pages may show? [Security, Spec §FR-003, FR-004]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the owner ruling against personal-history dates reflected in a measurable criterion? [Security, Spec §AC-30]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK035 Is the dependency on the design-first phase for the `/cv/` baselines documented, together with what CV4 adds? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, AC-50]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the assumption that `astro preview` serves `404.html` with status 404 recorded, so a failure can be traced to the server rather than the page? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK037 Is reliance on the existing schema test (rather than build-time validation) recorded? [Assumption, Spec §Clarifications]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Generated by the controller on the owner's delegation. Items are left for the owner (reviewer) to mark.
